mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 3.5% in a month signals improving labor market conditions, boosting investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when UNRATE crosses above 3.5% in recovery periods.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent drop in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in consumer demand (GDPC1) create upward pressure on prices, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases AND INDPRO decreases over 1 month
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when both GDPC1 rises and INDPRO falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained growth in consumer demand (GDPC1) signals robust corporate earnings and higher equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive during late-cycle expansions when GDPC1 shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.5% in tightening phases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over three months indicates potential supply constraints, driving up inflation expectations and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive when INDPRO declines in supply-side tightness periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a strengthening labor market, enhancing corporate performance and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases AND UNRATE decreases over 1 month
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when both PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate reduces growth expectations, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not negative during tightening phases when FEDFUNDS rises.
